== Summary ==

Crop rectangle <code>(134, 601, 1299, 2230)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>2e0af79fe77c06da43838fc242ed62a55a299cbe6df470b6dc43d5405577f2f1</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
